title: Business & Leadership
description: Build practical foundations in business, management and entrepreneurship, then progress toward higher-level leadership study.
disclaimer: This is a COSMO course-based study guide, not a BIICF competency framework or an ordered career ladder. Career possibilities are published by COSMO and do not guarantee employment or progression.

studyPath.title: Pearson BTEC Level 1 Introductory Diploma in Business
studyPath.entry: Age 16 or above with 2 O Level passes, 1 O Level credit in English medium, or another accepted qualification.

studyPath.title: Pearson BTEC International Level 2 Certificate in Business
studyPath.entry: 4 O Level passes, a Pearson BTEC International Level 1 Certificate, or another accepted qualification.

studyPath.title: Pearson BTEC International Level 3 Diploma in Business
studyPath.entry: 4 O Level credits, a Pearson BTEC Level 2 Certificate in Business, or another accepted business qualification.

studyPath.title: Pearson BTEC Level 5 Higher National Diploma in Business
studyPath.entry: An accepted Level 3, A Level, diploma or equivalent qualification. Confirm the current subject requirements with COSMO.

leadershipTopics: Managing and Running a Small Business
